title: How a P-Trap Blocks Sewer Gas
description: The P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage designed to hold a continuous volume of water within its curved dip. As waste water flows down the sink drain, it displaces the previous water and leaves a fresh liquid barrier behind. This standing water completely blocks the pipe interior, preventing sewer gases and volatile organic compounds from traveling up the main line into the building. Gravity maintains the fluid level while proper venting protects the seal from pressure fluctuations.

How a P-Trap Blocks Sewer Gas

The P-trap is a critical component of sink drainage designed to hold a continuous volume of water within its curved dip. As waste water flows down the sink drain, it displaces the previous water and leaves a fresh liquid barrier behind. This standing water completely blocks the pipe interior, preventing sewer gases and volatile organic compounds from traveling up the main line into the building. Gravity maintains the fluid level while proper venting protects the seal from pressure fluctuations.
